name: Manasa Devi Moola Mantra
text: ॐ ह्रीं श्रीं क्लीं ऐं मनसादेव्यै स्वाहा ॥
meaning: An invocation of Manasa Devi through the seed syllables and her name, ending with Svaha as an offering.
purpose: The Devi Bhagavata Purana gives this twelve-syllable mantra in its Manasa narrative; a shorter ten-syllable form is also in the text. It is associated with Manasa Devi’s worship.
supports: Courage in the face of fear; reflection on protection; respect for nature and the symbolism of serpents; steadiness during uncertainty.
when: If this mantra is part of your devotional practice, recite it with the guidance and method of the tradition you follow.
note: The source includes a specific japa count and ritual context; that count is not turned into a universal requirement here.
source: Devi Bhagavata Purana, book 9, chapter 48 (as cited in the client library)
